text: all the building pieces on the ground level do not touch the ground, they float above it a few inches — shown via painting green ground then floors over it, you can still see green at the floor edge
resolution: Duplicate of req_2024 (same 'floors float above the painted ground' report — req_2026 is the screenshot follow-up, req_2031 the relayed verbatim log). Fixed in 1ba22d852: the flat-plate decomposition in editors/build/pieceShapes.ts now keeps the solid core flush from piece.y up so floors/flat-roofs touch the ground instead of hanging ~12mm over it. See req_2024 for the full write-up and verification.
